title: sofr / repo / market structure | Data Release Other | SOFR Rate Observation - April 15, 2026
summary: The Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) closed at 3.72% on April 15, 2026, up 6 basis points from the prior day's reading of 3.66%. The rate has trended higher over the past five business days, rising from 3.57% on April 9 to the current level.
